analysis.summary: This is a honey peanut granola-style bar. Peanuts are a main ingredient, which matters most for your peanut allergy. It also has honey, and a cross-contact warning for tree nuts.

personalFlags.title: Contains peanuts
personalFlags.explanation: Peanuts are listed as an ingredient and in the allergen statement. This conflicts with your peanut allergy.

personalFlags.title: May contain tree nuts
personalFlags.explanation: The label says it may contain tree nuts and is made in a facility that processes them. This is a cross-contact risk for your tree nut allergy.
personalFlags.evidence: May contain tree nuts, milk, wheat and sesame.

personalFlags.title: Contains honey
personalFlags.explanation: Honey is made by bees and is not vegan.

personalFlags.title: May contain milk
personalFlags.explanation: A cross-contact line mentions milk. This may matter for a vegan diet; check with the maker if unsure.
personalFlags.evidence: May contain tree nuts, milk, wheat and sesame.

personalFlags.title: Natural flavor source unclear
personalFlags.explanation: Natural flavor can come from animal sources. Check with the maker if you want to be sure it is vegan.

labelWarnings.text: May contain milk, wheat, sesame and tree nuts; made in a facility that processes these allergens.
labelWarnings.evidence: Made in a facility that also processes these allergens.

keyFacts.label: Storage
keyFacts.value: Store in a cool, dry place.

analysis.disclaimer: If you have a severe allergy, avoid this product. Ask your doctor or pharmacist if you are unsure about anything.
